correctness.rationale: For n>=4 all leaves form a general-position set and all proper leaf subsets extend to it. A set of size at least three cannot use both a core and its private leaf, since that core lies on every path from its leaf to a third selected vertex. After rotating a selected core to 0, index the other occupied fibers. A pair of those indices with a shortest cycle route through 0 is forbidden, since pendant endpoints add the same lengths to both cycle routes. Put m=floor(n/2). The m-1 distinct matched pairs (-s,m-s), 1<=s<=m-1, are forbidden pairs: the route through 0 has length m, including an equally short route when n is even. At most n-m other fibers may be occupied. Equality is realized by the leaves at 1,...,m and, for odd n only, at -m, together with core 0. Two positive indices have a strictly shorter route avoiding 0, while in the odd case a route through 0 from -m to any positive listed index has length >m. No selected leaf is interior to a geodesic. Any extension retains the selected core and would exceed the established cardinality bound. Since ceil(n/2)+1<n for n>=4, only all leaves achieve n. The missing-size count between the two largest maximal cardinalities is floor(n/2)-2 for n>=6, with n=4,5 having no gap. Replay: RESULT.md lines 19–45. The frozen enumeration and matching script and recorded outputs were inspected, not executed; the finite checks do not establish the all-n result or say every smaller cardinality occurs.

evidence: A root at one of k>=3 selected support sites is allowed iff its preceding and following gaps a,b have a+b>n/2; other sites may take leaves. The prior counting argument explicitly bounds the remaining gap sum d by k-2<=d<=floor((n-1)/2).
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Immediately k<=ceil(n/2)+1 for any set containing a root. For n=2m take root-adjacent gaps 1,m and m-1 other unit gaps; for n=2m+1 take 1,m and m other unit gaps. Select just that root with leaves at other supported sites. This attains the bound by the earlier rule and is maximal since any extension still contains a root. Proper leaf sets extend, so there is no intermediate maximal size. This is a direct extremal consequence, not an independently unknown invariant.

value.rationale: A large gap in a maximal spectrum of subcubic graphs is a mathematically natural phenomenon. Here, however, the exact endpoint is obtained mechanically from the older same-family classification by bounding the remaining positive gaps and choosing unit gaps. The matching offers a clean restatement but no demonstrated structural or classification gain beyond that known result.
